crossRefs.note: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you…
All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much…
You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.
He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.
One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life…
You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance.
What will I give to Yahweh for all his benefits toward me?
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, as he has promised, that you shall keep this…
You shall tell your son in that day, saying, ‘It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.’
It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that Yahweh’s law may be in your…
It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of…
God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.
Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next…
Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!
Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.
I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us…
He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has…
He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.
but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”
So they glorified God in me.
although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly…
